children: Some economists have advanced their forecasts for an RBI rate hike to as early as October, overturning earlier expectations that rates would be held steady for the rest of the year amid surplus liquidity. IDFC First Bank and SBI Research expect a 25 bps increase next month due to a surge in crude prices amid fresh escalation in the West Asia tensions. Sangita Mehta reports.

title: Some Experts Expect Rate Hike in October
